name: Eszopiclone
class: Non-benzodiazepine GABA-A positive allosteric modulator (Schedule IV)
description: A cyclopyrrolone non-benzodiazepine hypnotic approved for insomnia, with a longer duration of action than zolpidem. Carries a boxed warning for complex sleep behaviours.

systems.note: GABA-A positive allosteric modulation; the labelled indication.
Hepatically metabolised via CYP3A4; dose limits are labelled in hepatic impairment.

monitors.why: Labelled dose limits in hepatic impairment.
Boxed complex sleep behaviours and labelled next-day impairment.
